project_type: Next.js 15 App Router portfolio site with Tailwind CSS 3 + Framer Motion
build_system: npm with Next.js, no special build tooling
test_framework: No test framework set up - this is a portfolio site. Verification is via build success.
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to ensure TypeScript compiles and Next.js static generation succeeds without errors.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node v22 available.
contribution_requirements: Dark-only theme (no light mode). No backdrop-filter on glass cards (causes jitter). Lenis uses lerp not duration. Content lives in /content/*.ts files.
key_patterns: Components use 'use client' directive for client-side features. Framer Motion for animations. CSS custom properties for design tokens in globals.css. Tailwind classes extended via tailwind.config.ts. Effects are in components/effects/, sections in components/sections/. Profile data imported from @/content/profile.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and global styles. components/ - React components split into effects/ (visual effects) and sections/ (page sections). content/ - TypeScript data files for resume content. lib/ - utility functions (cn helper). tailwind.config.ts - Tailwind configuration with custom colors/fonts/animations.
